title: The Secret of the Ancient Clock Tower
synopsis: The Whisper Crystal's hologram leads the friends into an enchanted forest where time runs strangely: an apple falls and jumps back onto its branch, leaves drift up, butterflies fly backward, Kiko strolls backward as if it's normal, a banana peel vanishes and reappears, and Draco's 'time magic' spins him dizzy ('this forest needs a clock repairman!'). At the Ancient Clock Tower, tiny owl Tock ('You're late! You're early! You're... yesterday!') explains the Master Clock has stopped, and announces it is 'Banana o'clock!'. Inside, a time glitch makes Bobo slip three times in a loop, Kiko uses a loop button to make him dance twice, and Draco flies through a portal and comes out facing the wrong way. The clock's two hands are missing: Draco rides a turning floor gear while Kiko grabs one from a pendulum, and Bobo tries to bite the other ('it looks delicious!'). Tock is scared to repair the clock alone; Lumi encourages him, Draco's warm puff thaws a frozen gear, Kiko turns a crank, Bobo accidentally presses the giant button and shakes the tower, and Tock guides the hands home: the clock ticks again ('banana o'clock!'). Kiko moves Tock's clock forward ('late for tomorrow!'), and this time Bobo catches Kiko trying to steal his golden banana.
ending: The Master Clock projects a giant rainbow bridge leading to a kingdom in the clouds. 'Another mystery! Come on, friends. Our next adventure is waiting!' Next: The Mystery of the Rainbow Bridge.
newCharacters: Tock, a tiny fluffy golden-brown baby owl and guardian of the Ancient Clock Tower: big turquoise eyes, tiny golden spectacles, a small golden clock pendant, ear tufts, tiny wings and orange feet; loves clocks and always gets the time wrong (Tock in src/ep12/props.tsx, voice bm_george pitched 1.32)
